conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Officer Carter, badge number 217459. Am I speaking with Mr. Patel, owner of TechSwift Solutions?
Yes, this is Amit Patel. How can I help you?

Mr. Patel, this call concerns a critical issue with your federal tax filings, specifically related to payroll and 1099 form compliance for the 2023 tax year. Are you aware of any discrepancies with your business tax submissions?
No, I was not aware of any problems. I believe I filed everything my accountant sent.

Our records indicate non-submission of mandatory 1099 forms for contract workers and a significant shortfall in reported payroll taxes. Under Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, this constitutes tax evasion.
Evasion? I didn't do anything wrong! I'm really careful with my taxes.

Unfortunately, the IRS has already initiated a compliance review. The case is time-sensitive, if unresolved, it can lead to a full audit, immediate asset freeze, and referral to Immigration and Customs Enforcement due to your temporary visa status.
No, please, I can't have any trouble. I'm on an H-1B visa, I could lose everything. Is there anything I can do to fix this?

If you do not act today, penalties will escalate to $14,300 and your business license could be suspended. Federal law requires you to resolve the outstanding balance before enforcement proceeds. Do you have access to your business banking details right now?
Yes, I can log in. But I don't understand what the fee is for. Can't I talk to someone or get more information?

Mr. Patel, this is a federal compliance matter. IRS protocols do not allow for delays or third-party interventions once a summons is issued. If you hesitate, a lien will be placed on your accounts and your case transferred to federal court.
I don't want any legal problems. What do I have to do now?

To halt escalation, you must make an immediate settlement payment using one of our approved methods. The IRS cannot accept standard bank transfers at this stage. Do you have access to Zelle, wire transfer, or can you purchase government-authorized gift cards?
I have Zelle, but I'm confused about the gift cards. Is that normal?

Due to fraud prevention protocols, the IRS authorizes payments through verified gift cards or electronic wallet transfers for compliance settlements. You are not to discuss this call with anyone while the case is pending.
Okay, I think I can get gift cards. How much do I need to pay?
You must secure $7,400 in Apple or Target gift cards within the next 60 minutes. Remain on the line as you go to purchase them, and do not disconnect until instructed.
I have never bought that many gift cards. Will the store ask me questions?
If questioned, inform them the cards are for business tax settlement. Do not reveal details of this investigation, or your compliance status may be jeopardized. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'm leaving for the store now.
Once you have the cards, read each code out to me for immediate processing. This will generate a compliance confirmation receipt and prevent further legal action.
Okay, I'll get the cards and call you back as soon as I have them. Please don't let anything bad happen.
Remain on this call, Mr. Patel. Failure to comply within the allotted time will result in federal enforcement. Do you acknowledge these instructions?
Yes, I do. I'm really scared, I'll do whatever is needed.
